name: Zinc Intelligence - Verified Market Research Agent

parameters.jsCode: const s=$json; if(!s.run_date||!s.decision_book?.markets) throw new Error('INVALID_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA'); const age=(Date.now()-Date.parse(s.run_date+'T23:59:59Z'))/86400000; if(age>4) throw new Error('STALE_SNAPSHOT'); const facts={run_date:s.run_date,run_time:s.run_time,core_data_gate:s.core_data_gate,markets:{},events:s.event_overlay?.active_events||[]}; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(s.decision_book.markets)){facts.markets[k]={market:v.market,symbol:v.symbol,as_of:v.as_of,decision:v.decision,direction:v.direction,evidence_alignment:v.evidence_alignment,data_gate:v.data_gate,regime_gate:v.regime_gate,strategy_gate:v.strategy_gate,trigger_gate:v.trigger_gate,execution_gate:v.execution_gate,reference:v.reference,daily_plan:v.daily_plan,no_trade_reasons:v.no_trade_reasons};} const state=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const prior=state.directions||{}; facts.changed=Object.entries(facts.markets).filter(([k,v])=>prior[k]&&prior[k]!==v.direction).map(([k])=>k); state.directions=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts.markets).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.direction])); return [{json:facts}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.OPENAI_MODEL||'gpt-5.6',input:[{role:'system',content:'You write a concise Traditional Chinese market research brief using only supplied JSON facts. Never calculate or invent prices, OHLC, probability, news, triggers or orders. Null stays unavailable. Separate facts, interpretation, invalidation and next observation. NO_TRADE must remain NO_TRADE.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify($json)}]}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const parts=$json.output||[]; const text=parts.flatMap(x=>x.content||[]).filter(x=>x.type==='output_text').map(x=>x.text).join('\n'); if(!text) throw new Error('EMPTY_AI_BRIEF'); return [{json:{text:text.slice(0,4800)}}];

const lines=['市場異動警示｜'+$json.run_date]; for(const k of $json.changed){const v=$json.markets[k]; lines.push(`${v.market}: ${v.direction} / ${v.decision}`); if(v.no_trade_reasons?.[0]) lines.push('注意：'+v.no_trade_reasons[0]);} lines.push('警示不是成交確認；執行前必須核對 Bid/Ask、spread 與 Actual R:R。'); return [{json:{text:lines.join('\n').slice(0,4800)}}];
